title: Nice size
text: Nice size. Frame is nice if you like the vintage look, picture goes on easily but a little part of the frame was tarnished- but it's hardly seen. Pretty good for the price.

product_metadata.title: Laura Ashley 4x6 Silver Rope Metal Picture Frame (Vertical) with Pull-Out Easel Stand, Made for Tabletop, Counterspace, Shelf and Desk
features: LAURA ASHLEY BRINGS PHOTOS TO LIFE: Frames aren’t just for displaying your photos- they serve as essential home décor pieces that can transform any room into the soothing and beautiful living spaces that fill us with warmth throughout the seasons. This Laura Ashley frame is a wonderful choice to display your precious memories. This classic design makes the frame a brilliant addition to any room in your home, while complimenting any shelf, cabinet, coffee table or desk that it rests on.

ELEGANT DESIGN: The stylish rope edges that surround the glass panes create the feeling of understated elegance. This eye-catching metal frame reflects light in a subtle way that brightens up any interior space. The sturdiness of the swinging easel allows the frame to rest solidly on any countertop in your home. The narrow design of this gorgeous frame gives off an alluring quality that captures the beauty in your favorite portrait shots.

EASY TO USE: The solid design of this narrow metal frame and easel make it easy to move from room to room. Simply pull out the easel to stand it on any flat surface. To replace a photo inside- remove the clear sticker and gently push the glass pane away from the front of the frame. Slide the glass pane up from the bottom of the frame. [NOTES: (1) This Frame Can Not Be Mounted on a Wall! (2) This Vertical Frame Does Not Stand Horizontally!]

SOPHISTICATED DISPLAY: Whether it is perched attractively on a windowsill or serving as a sharp-looking addition on top of your accent cabinet, this modern frame draws the eye to the history in your family photos. Wherever you place it in your home, the frame captures the wonder in the snapshots taken of the world around you. The striking appearance of the frame recalls the tradition that inspired its design. Turn your favorite photos into timeless treasures with these chic frames.

GIFT POTENTIAL: Once you see how well this radiant metal frame elevates the look of the room you place it in, you may want to add a companion frame to join it on the desk or mantlepiece. This attractive frame is a thoughtful gift that will personalize the decor of any room and any interior space. Your Mom, grandmother, sister, friends and co-workers will share in the joy of displaying their photos in style in these beautiful frames.

The thin, metal edges to this attractive frame, reflects light in a subtle way that brightens the tiniest of spaces. This charming addition to your living space will draw attention to the beauty of family photos, and transport you to the moment you captured stunning architecture in your area or on your favorite vacations. Whether this frame is perched on a mantlepiece, used as an attractive accessory on a shelf, or a decorative piece on the corner of a desk, the frame will provide a stylish boost to your favorite living spaces. The sturdy metal easel allows this frame to rest solidly on any countertop. The thin edges of the metallic borders that surround the glass, give both sides of this vertical frame a clean look that really shines. Gazing at the memories preserved in this gorgeous frame may lift your mood while the frame accentuates the décor of your interior spaces. Take the snapshots of your favorite everyday moments, whether it’s the beauty of the world around you, or your child’s laughter, and turn them into timeless treasures. Display cherished birthday and graduation memories at home in these sophisticated looking, decorative frames or use them as chic display frames for wedding receptions. Share the joy these frames bring you with your friends, family, and co-workers, as they make a thoughtful gift for the holidays or any season. [NOTES: (1) This Frame Can Not Be Mounted on a Wall!
